statusInterpretation.preparedArt: Library/PreparedArt and build payloads are derived caches and are outside this source-count scope.

evidence.playModeAndPlayerConclusion: Not asserted by this source registry; consult current integration QA.

unityEditorSnapshot.scope: Entire Editor test run at this snapshot, not a per-clip GPU or Player proof. Local Library evidence is not a committed runtime dependency.
